rawFindings.title: Comment-length exceptions are ignored when `comments` is set to 0
rawFindings.explanation: `commentLengthApplies` is computed as `lineIsComment && maxCommentLength`, so a configured comment limit of `0` is treated as falsy and the comment-length branch is skipped entirely. After this change, `{"max-len": ["error", {"comments": 0}]}` no longer reports any comment lines, even though a zero limit should make every comment too long.
rawFindings.suggestion: Test the option explicitly for presence, e.g. `const commentLengthApplies = lineIsComment && maxCommentLength !== undefined;` and keep the numeric comparison against `maxCommentLength`.
rawFindings.failureAfterChange:
With `/* eslint max-len: ["error", {"comments": 0}] */
// abc`, ESLint reports no max-len violation for the comment line.
